message: Build a single comprehensive master Word document called ExCELLsis_Master_Document.docx for TSA Biotechnology Design nationals. Merge and rebase everything from Biotech.pdf, ExCELLsis_Project_Summary.docx, and ExCELLsis_30Day_Plan.docx into 17 ordered sections: (1) Title page with team quick-ref and scoring summary, (2) Critical Compliance Flags (GenAI prohibition, power rules, display size, children's museum), (3) Event Structure and Scoring with full rubric tables from Biotech.pdf, (4) Project Overview (bioconjugation topic, two research angles, differentiation table), (5) Team Roles — Surya=AI+Presents, Sangle=AI+CAD+Presents, Arjun=Portfolio Lead, Chris=Biology+Flex, Shravya=Biology+Flex, Csoni=Hardware, (6) Hardware Specifications, (7) Enclosure Design with Glowforge workflow and children's museum alert, (8) Power System, (9) Wiring Summary (19 connections), (10) AI Model with Hailo-10H specifics and CSI/Health Score formulas, (11) Software Architecture, (12) Biology Experiment (6 conditions, CSI validation samples), (13) Documentation Portfolio rules and section breakdown, (14) Display Design with Explanation of Impacts breakdown, (15) Presentation Guide with 7-minute script and top 10 judge questions, (16) Full Parts List ~$900-1100, (17) 29-Day Execution Plan May 25 to June 22. Dark blue #1B4F8A and mid blue #2E75B6 primary colors, member colors per person, alert boxes in red/gold/green/blue, alternating table rows, Arial throughout. Run validation after generation.

Validator passes 0 errors — 16/16 section headings detected, 31/31 required keyword groups present. Archived ExCELLsis_Project_Summary.docx and ExCELLsis_30Day_Plan.docx to archive/. Overall enclosure: 254mm W x 356mm H x 127mm D (10" x 14" x 5"). Front panel zones top to bottom: Top bar 19mm, Display zone 146mm, Control row 19mm, Optical chamber 114mm, Bottom panel 58mm. Optical chamber module outer: 127 x 114 x 70mm. Interior clear: 114 x 102 x 70mm. Slide slot: 79 x 28mm (fits standard 75 x 25mm slide). Slide platform 38mm above chamber floor. Camera-to-slide 51mm nominal ±12.7mm. Display active area 217.4 x 135.9mm. Full breakdown in Section 7 of master doc.
whats the thickness of each face? should be the same except for in high stress areas

Current spec: all 6 structural shell panels = 6mm clear acrylic (uniform). Bezel strips + chamber cover = 3mm black acrylic (cosmetic). For high-stress reinforcement, recommended adding internal 3mm doublers rather than changing to 8mm full panels — keeps Glowforge toolpath on one sheet thickness and slot-and-tab math consistent. Two zones: (1) Bottom panel under battery compartment (4x ~150g LiPo packs), (2) Front panel around display + chamber cutouts (large openings = stress concentration). Chamber cover (hinged, no structural load) stays 3mm. Bezel/accents stay 3mm.
give me the face dimensions in mm, not the thickness, but the length and width. and then also the overall length and width

Overall outer: 254mm W x 356mm H x 127mm D. Outer face dimensions: Front/Back = 254 x 356mm, Left/Right sides = 127 x 356mm, Top/Bottom = 254 x 127mm. Cut-panel sizes vary by joinery — with box/finger joints (recommended for Glowforge) all panels equal outer dims and tabs interlock. With butt joints, inset panels subtract 12mm (2x wall thickness) from the overlapping direction. Glowforge cannot cut true 45-degree miters (laser cuts perpendicular only), so box/finger joints are the practical route; miter the design intent in CAD.
and then what about the camera slide cutout dimensions (depth width and height)

Chamber module outer envelope: 127 W x 114 H x 70 D mm. Interior clear space: 114 W x 102 H x 70 D mm (after 6mm walls). Front-panel chamber opening (cutout in main front face): 127 x 114mm. Slide insertion slot in chamber side wall: 79 x 28mm (W x H), positioned 38mm above chamber floor, slot depth 6mm (through-cut through wall). Camera mounting hole in top bracket: 25-30mm diameter for Arducam C-mount 12mm lens body (1" / 25.4mm C-mount thread), surrounded by WS2812B ring (~50mm ID, ~70mm OD). Camera-to-slide focal: 51mm nominal, adjustable ±12.7mm via slotted mount.

give me a prompt for ADAM AI for onshape to cad this. Make sure the dimensions are precise and I want the full assembly as well as each side. Each side should be mitered for each assembly and for points where I cut into the overall box (for the camera module stuff and the power module) make sure it knows to make additional mitered faces.

Wrote a full self-contained ADAM AI prompt for Onshape covering: coordinate system (origin front-lower-left, +X width, +Y depth, +Z height, all mm), overall envelope 254 x 356 x 127mm, all 6 panels with exact outer face dims and miter callouts, all cutouts with precise X/Y/Z positions (display 220x140mm, buttons, chamber opening 127x114mm with mitered inner edges, power door 80x100mm with mitered inner edges, slide slot, voltage meter hole, vent slots), Chamber sub-module A (5-sided box with hinged 3mm cover, floor slide pocket 79x28x1mm, camera mount 30mm hole in top wall, all perimeter edges mitered, front edges mitered to mate with front panel cutout), Power Module frame B (4-wall frame 80x100mm with hinged door, mitered into right panel cutout), full assembly mate instructions and exploded view callout. Also flagged: Glowforge cannot cut true 45-degree miters, ADAM AI may push back — fallback to box/finger joints on cut files while preserving miter design intent in CAD model.
